g.text: One checklist connects the complete agent workflow
Replace broad goals such as accuracy and safety with behavior a reviewer and test can recognize.

g.text: User, accepted work, baseline and acceptance.
Can a reviewer recognize completed work?
Can each material claim be reproduced?
Can a denied action bypass the boundary?
Which serious failure could still receive a pass?
Can failure be diagnosed and repair verified?
Retain versions, disagreement and accepted limits. A new source, user group, tool or permission can change exposure
without changing the prompt; reassess when uncertainty could alter the decision.
Proposed synthesis connecting the conference’s task, evidence, authority, evaluation and operation mechanisms.
